selected_update_statistics.gradient_rule: Mean over episodes of -advantage times sum of categorical target log probabilities; previous-update case EMA baseline. No parameter-space score gradient.

tuned_fixed.note: Fixed configuration selected by a prospective grid; no evolutionary credit

selection_rule: Native, strong anchor, tuned-fixed training winner, CMA best-trained, random best-trained and REINFORCE best-trained. Within each search arm compare its candidate to the common strong-anchor selection tuple; retain candidate only if strictly better, otherwise labeled untrained anchor. Exact ties retain anchor. All six arms use the same case/environment seeds and deterministic argmax policies, including duplicate-parameter nominees, and every execution is charged.
final_lock_rule: After selection, persist each selected parameter vector, is_trained flag, producer run/update/candidate provenance and selection score/input/output hashes. No further tuning once final reservation opens.
